name: ChromaGrid-TS-TW
blurb: Grid cards respond to cursor with a light glow that follows the mouse.
description: Displays a grid of cards with cursor-responsive light glow effect. Cards fade in and out based on proximity. Uses GSAP for smooth easing and damping.
use_when: Team member grids, testimonial sections, or showcase galleries.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices; hover/cursor effect is desktop-only.
a11y: Cards are divs with images and text. No aria labels or keyboard interaction.
